title: custom:swipe-card-pro
description: Any cards side by side in a strip you swipe through, snapping to each card, with dots below; a grid from a number of view columns on.

per_page.description: How many cards fit across the strip; a fraction lets the next card peek in

gap.description: The space between the cards. Default: the theme's section gap

padding.description: Space around the cards; its left and right are the inset at both ends of the strip

snap.description: Where a card stops: at the start, centred, or free scrolling

height.description: equal: every card as tall as the tallest; auto: each its own height

indicator.description: The dots below the strip, one per page

unfold.description: From this many view columns on, the cards are a grid instead of a strip; null: never

from.description: The view columns the card spans (its section's column_span)
